BiblicalUsage: Kesalon is a town on the northern border of Judah, named in the allotment. Joshua 15:10 says the border passed along unto the side of mount Jearim, which is Chesalon, on the north side, and went down to Beth-shemesh.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe every border town in the allotment matters, because God drew the lines of his people's inheritance himself.
